title: CTA band shows headline and Contact button
test_data: Expected headline: Transforming glass since 1983. ; button: Contact
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Scroll to the call-to-action band above the footer
expected_result: The band shows "Transforming glass since 1983." and a visible "Contact" button.

title: CTA Contact button opens the Contact page
test_data: Expected destination: /contact (no trailing slash in href; final URL may redirect to /contact/)
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Scroll to the CTA band
Click the "Contact" button
expected_result: The Contact page loads (HTTP 200, no error page). Either /contact or /contact/ is accepted as the final URL.

title: Footer shows the company address
test_data: Expected address: Skyline 1240 N Homan Ave Chicago, IL 60651
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Scroll to the footer
Read the address block
expected_result: The footer address reads "Skyline 1240 N Homan Ave Chicago, IL 60651".

title: Footer email is a working mailto link
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Scroll to the footer
Read the email text and the href of the link
expected_result: The text is "sales@skyline.glass" and the link href is mailto:sales@skyline.glass.

title: Footer phone number shows the live value and is a tel link
test_data: Expected: 773-278-4660 (the Jul 2025 checklist value 773-825-6203 is considered stale)
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Scroll to the footer
Read the phone text and the href of the link
expected_result: The phone text is "773-278-4660" and the link href is a tel: link with the same number.

title: Four social links are present and open safely in a new tab
test_data: Expected: Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube; target=_blank; rel includes noopener
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Scroll to the footer
Read href, target and rel of the four social links
expected_result: There are exactly 4 social links (Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube), each with target="_blank" and rel containing "noopener". Only attributes are asserted, never the content of the social pages (they block automation).

title: Clicking a social link opens a new tab and keeps the About page
test_data: Link: Instagram (any social link may be used)
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Scroll to the footer
Click the Instagram social icon
expected_result: A new tab/window opens for the social URL and the original tab still shows /about/. Content of the social page is not asserted.

title: All social links use HTTPS
test_data: Expected scheme: https:// for Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube (currently YouTube is http://www.youtube.com/@skyline-glass)
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Scroll to the footer
Read the href of each social link and check its scheme
expected_result: All four hrefs start with https://. An http:// link is a defect (the browser blocks it as Mixed Content).
